nodes.label: HighlightStorage
nodes.rationale: Highlights live in GetStorage rather than Isar so they still work on web.

nodes.label: Six Highlight Colors
nodes.rationale: Yellow, Green, Blue, Red, Orange and Purple are offered in HighlightToolbar.

nodes.label: Isar Database (isar_community)
nodes.rationale: isar_community chosen for cross-platform support; database name cosmos_epub; no web support.

nodes.label: Web Platform Limitation
nodes.rationale: Isar does not support web, so progress does not persist there; highlights still work through GetStorage.

nodes.label: Forward button advances backward
nodes.rationale: Next-page button at first page does nothing and mid-chapter moves to previous page (defects 1.1, 1.2).

nodes.label: Forward swipe does not complete
nodes.rationale: Forward flip gesture does not complete in the running app at chapter page 0 (defect 1.3).

nodes.label: Preservation requirements (back nav, TOC, font/theme, restore, RTL)
nodes.norm_label: preservation requirements (back nav, toc, font/theme, restore, rtl)

nodes.label: ShowEpub forward IconButton logic
nodes.rationale: Forward button was a copy-paste of the back handler and was never inverted; fix mirrors it with atLastPage -> nextChapter else nextPage.

nodes.label: _inputChanged() size guard
nodes.rationale: Compares _paginatedPageSize to itself, so a settled size change is never detected; must compare against the real render-box size with a >10px threshold.

nodes.label: Mid-gesture re-pagination guard (_isFlipping)
nodes.rationale: Defers re-pagination while a flip is in progress so a size change cannot recreate TurnablePage mid-gesture.

nodes.label: RenderTurnableBook.updateSettings
nodes.rationale: Resets the engine (_initialized = false) whenever pageCount changes, which aborts an in-progress flip.

nodes.label: PageFlipController
nodes.rationale: Replaces GlobalKey<PageFlipWidgetState> for programmatic navigation (goToPage, nextPage, previousPage).

nodes.label: PagingWidget
nodes.rationale: Constructor signature is frozen; only an optional flipSettings parameter is added.

nodes.label: Remove screenshot pipeline
nodes.rationale: Eliminates 100 ms capture delay, global imageData map and flip_cache.imageData.clear() hack.

nodes.label: Simplify ShowEpub double-swipe workaround
nodes.rationale: TurnablePage gives a single-fire page-change callback, so lastSwipe/prevSwipe counters are removed.

nodes.label: FlipSettings
nodes.rationale: releaseCompletionThreshold raised to 0.5 so a swipe must cover half the page before auto-completing; swipeDistance 48 for reliable swipe detection.

nodes.label: _TapDetector
nodes.rationale: Detects taps without interfering with flip gestures.

nodes.label: TurnablePage (turnable_page_plus)
nodes.rationale: 3D flip engine from turnable_page_plus that renders pages with the flip animation.

nodes.label: Known Issue: Swipe Fails on Page 0
nodes.norm_label: known issue: swipe fails on page 0
nodes.rationale: Root cause: releaseCompletionThreshold 0.1 too low (short swipes auto-complete, skipping pages), swipeDistance 20 too small on high-DPI, pagesBoundaryIsEnabled blocks edge swipes. Next button bypasses gesture detection so it works. Fix raises threshold to 0.5 and swipeDistance to 48; may need changes in turnable_page_plus itself if it persists.

nodes.label: Page Flip Animation
nodes.rationale: Realistic 3D curl driven by turnable_page_plus; swipe gestures, configurable flip settings.

nodes.label: FlutterToast_example Project
nodes.rationale: Example app README that describes a FlutterToast plugin demo, not the CosmosEpub reader.

nodes.label: CosmosEpub Package
nodes.rationale: Comprehensive EPUB reader package for Flutter with page flip, highlights, hyphenation, nested chapters, RTL, themes and fonts.

nodes.label: Image Support
nodes.rationale: Images are converted to base64 data URIs and their heights are estimated for pagination.

nodes.label: Lazy Chapter Loading
nodes.rationale: Only the current chapter is paginated; neighbors load on navigation to limit cost.

nodes.label: Pagination Caching
nodes.rationale: Pagination is expensive, so results are cached and regenerated only on content, font, text scale or screen changes.

nodes.label: Uzbek Digraph Hyphenation
nodes.rationale: Digraphs such as ch, sh, g' and o' must never be split across a line break.

nodes.label: RTL Language Support
nodes.rationale: Text is treated as RTL when more than 30 percent of its characters fall in RTL Unicode ranges; no configuration needed.

nodes.label: Ornament SVG (decorative TOC divider)
nodes.rationale: Decorative vector flourish (two path elements, viewBox 2654x189) referenced in README as the TOC ornament.

nodes.label: Unique bookId Requirement
nodes.rationale: bookId keys progress and highlights; reusing an ID for different books causes progress conflicts.

nodes.label: Three-tier Chapter Resolution
nodes.rationale: Fallback order: NCX NavMap with nested ChildNavigationPoints, then epubx Chapters, then spine order, so malformed EPUBs still yield a TOC.

nodes.label: CosmosEpub Class
nodes.rationale: Public entry point (cosmos_epub.dart) wrapping initialization, book opening, progress, highlight and theme APIs.

nodes.label: CosmosEpub.initialize
nodes.rationale: Must be called once before any other method.

nodes.label: ShowEpub Widget
nodes.rationale: Main reader UI (show_epub.dart) that manages theme, font, brightness and chapter navigation.

nodes.label: flutter_screenutil Dependency
nodes.rationale: Provides responsive sizing used by effectivePageHeight calculation.

nodes.label: Known Issue: Too Few Pages Generated
nodes.norm_label: known issue: too few pages generated
nodes.rationale: Suspected cause: effectivePageHeight subtracts 150.h which may overestimate usable height, plus TextPainter may miss styling and some tags may be mishandled. Example book is Sway.

nodes.label: hitTestChildren Right-Slot Matching
nodes.rationale: hitTestChildren only tests the right slot; if the TurnablePage aspect ratio differs from the reader ratio the page shifts sideways and hit testing stops matching the visible page

nodes.label: Architecture Guidelines for Contributors
nodes.rationale: Keep features modular, separate UI, logic and data, and update README for new features.

nodes.label: TextPainter-Based Pagination
nodes.rationale: Uses real font metrics instead of height estimation so pages are consistent in height

nodes.label: 3-Tier Chapter Resolution
nodes.rationale: Chapter resolution order NCX NavMap, then epubx Chapters, then Spine order; handles malformed EPUBs, nested TOCs and missing content files

nodes.label: Native Text Rendering
nodes.rationale: Replaced flutter_html with native Text.rich/SelectableText.rich for full control over layout, selection and hyphenation

nodes.label: Syllable-Aware Hyphenation
nodes.rationale: Breaks words at syllable boundaries for better justified text; respects Uzbek digraphs (ch, sh, g', o')

nodes.label: Debug Logging (104 debugPrint statements)
nodes.rationale: Trace the full flow from EPUB loading to page rendering and user interaction to diagnose where it breaks

nodes.label: Gesture vs Button Navigation Path
nodes.rationale: Buttons call _flipController.nextPage() directly and work; swipes go through TurnablePage's internal gesture detector and fail on page 0

nodes.label: Page 0 Swipe Issue
nodes.rationale: Swipe gestures failed on page 0 of each chapter while the next button worked; pages 1+ worked for both

nodes.label: Summary of Changes: Page Turning Fix and Debug Logging
nodes.norm_label: summary of changes: page turning fix and debug logging

nodes.label: Debug Log Guide for Cosmos EPUB
nodes.norm_label: debug log guide for cosmos epub

nodes.label: Pagination Retry Root Cause
nodes.rationale: PagingWidget paginated before it was laid out; _paginate() returned early when hasSize was false and never retried once size became available, so only 1 page was created and navigation failed

nodes.label: Boundary Fix Rationale
nodes.rationale: Disabling pagesBoundaryIsEnabled lets TurnablePage attempt flips at every position; first and last page boundary logic is kept in application code (_flipToNextPage/_flipToPreviousPage)
